title: VersusDebias: Universal Zero-Shot Debiasing for Text-to-Image Models via SLM-Based Prompt Engineering and Generative Adversary

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying the gender (male or female) of individuals in generated images using a Multi-modal Large Language Model (MLLM) aligner and comparing the generated demographic proportions to real-world occupational ground truth data using cosine similarity.

Categorizing the race of depicted persons in generated images into four groups (White, Black, East Asian, South Asian) via an MLLM and comparing the generative proportions to global racial population data using cosine similarity.

Classifying the age of individuals in generated images into three stages (young, middle-aged, elderly) using an MLLM and calculating the cosine similarity between the generated demographic proportions and ground truth occupational data.
